title: Silver Coin Gift Tax Exclusion Amounts
takeaway: The IRS offers annual and lifetime gift tax exclusions, allowing significant gifting without immediate tax implications.

data.label: Annual Exclusion (2024)
data.evidence: The IRS offers an annual gift tax exclusion. In 2024, you can gift up to $18,000 per recipient per year without triggering gift tax.

data.label: Annual Exclusion (2023)
data.evidence: The IRS adjusts this amount annually for inflation. As of 2023, the annual exclusion has been $17,000.

data.label: Lifetime Exclusion (2024)
data.evidence: Beyond the annual exclusion, there’s also a lifetime exclusion. As of 2024, the lifetime gift and estate tax exclusion is $13.61 million per individual.

narration: The IRS provides significant protections against gift tax liability through annual and lifetime exclusions. These exclusions allow for substantial gifting without immediate tax consequences, offering a valuable tool for wealth transfer. Reporting is still required, but the amounts are substantial.
